---
title: "Run status"
subtitle: "When each stage last ran, how it ended and whether its outputs are current"
---

```{r}
source("_helpers.R")
```

Each stage is its own launch. The result comes from Nextflow's history of this run's launches, as `cosmx-nf `r RUN$id`` reports it. A stage is **outdated** when everything it wrote is older than the object it reads, because that object was rebuilt after it ran.

## Stages

```{r}
st <- lapply(STAGES, stage_status)
st <- st[vapply(st, function(x) x$state != "none" || x$stage %in% c("discover", "annotate", "spatial", "cci", "de"), logical(1))]
tags$table(
  class = "table table-sm plain",
  tags$thead(tags$tr(
    tags$th("Stage"), tags$th("Result"), tags$th("Last launch"), tags$th("Took"),
    tags$th("Launches"), tags$th("Options")
  )),
  tags$tbody(lapply(st, function(x) {
    tags$tr(
      tags$td(tags$code(x$stage)), tags$td(badge(x)), tags$td(x$time), tags$td(x$duration),
      tags$td(if (x$launches) x$launches else ""), tags$td(if (nzchar(x$options)) tags$code(x$options))
    )
  }))
)
```

```{r}
if (!nrow(launches())) {
  tags$p(class = "table-note", "This build found no launch history, so each stage is judged by the files in results/.")
}
```

- **done**: the last launch finished, or the stage's outputs are in `results/` from a launch in another folder.
- **outdated**: the stage finished before the object it reads was rebuilt.
- **running now**: the launch that built this site.
- **failed** or **stopped**: the last launch ended with an error, or was stopped before the end.
- **not run**: no launch and no outputs.

## Labels

```{r}
lab <- labels_state()
tags$p(badge(lab), " ", lab$text)
```

## Commands

- `cosmx-nf `r RUN$id`` shows the same status in the terminal and names the next command.
- `cosmx-nf `r RUN$id` <stage>` runs a stage. It resumes the stage's last launch.
- `cosmx-nf `r RUN$id` report` rebuilds this site from what is in `results/`.
